title: Build self-attention from scratch
brief: Write a causal mask, a stable softmax, single-head and multi-head attention, the backward pass, and a flop counter.
hints: causal_mask: start from np.zeros((T, T)) and set mask[np.triu_indices(T, k=1)] = -np.inf. Use k=1 so the diagonal stays 0.
softmax: subtract np.max(x, axis=axis, keepdims=True) before np.exp, then divide by np.sum(..., axis=axis, keepdims=True).
scaled_dot_product_attention: scores = q @ k.T / np.sqrt(q.shape[-1]). Add the mask to the scores before the softmax, never after.
multi_head_attention: compute Q = x @ Wq once, then for head i take columns i*d_k to (i+1)*d_k, run attention on that slice, np.concatenate the outputs along axis=-1, and multiply by Wo.
attention_backward: dv = weights.T @ dout, dweights = dout @ v.T, dscores = weights * (dweights - rowsum(weights * dweights)), then dq = dscores @ k / sqrt(d_k) and dk = dscores.T @ q / sqrt(d_k).
